bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are not allowed in the facility. All bags will be checked upon entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The T-Mobile Center offers convenient on-site parking in the Magenta Lot, available for advance purchase on a first-come, first-served basis. Additional parking is available at the Red Lot Parking Garage and the Yellow Lot Parking Garage. Parking links for concerts can be found on individual event pages.

rideshare.note: Use the area near the Oak Street entrance for rideshare, taxi, limousine, and accessible pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: T-Mobile Center sells a range of food and beverages across arena concessions. Outside food and beverages are prohibited, and the venue operates cash-free points of sale.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy accessible seating through AXS.com, Ticketmaster.com, or ticketoffice@t-mobilecenter.com, and indicate your needs when ordering. Free wheelchair escorts are available at each entry point, and Guest Services provides assistive listening devices and can store your wheelchair if you transfer to a seat. Service animals must stay leashed or harnessed; the relief area is on the Oak Street side.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office at T-Mobile Center opens 3 hours prior to show time. *Please note on some events that begin prior to 12pm, the Box Office may have modified hours.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Guest entrances are at Grand Boulevard (13th Street and Grand Blvd), Oak Street (Oak Street and 13th Terrace), and the Founders Club entrance south of the Box Office. GA ticket holders line up at the Oak Street entrance; check your event page for lineup times. Premium Plus ticket holders use the first two doors on the left at Oak Street.
